name: Iron
description: Reasonably tough and heat resistant given its modest weight.

name: Steel
description: Very hard and high performance metal for its weight.

name: Nickel
description: Versatile thanks to its medium weight and a few weaknesses.

name: Copper
description: A great conductor but otherwise unexceptional.

name: Bronze
description: Capable of withstanding a lot of stress for its medium weight.

name: Titanium
description: Very light for such a hard metal but a bad conductor.

name: Aluminium
description: Extremely light without compromising too much on strength

name: Tin
description: Lightweight but weak, soft and susceptible to heat.

name: Silver
description: A jack of all trades but master of only conductivity.

name: Lead
description: Durable and strong but too heavy for many uses.

name: Gold
description: Dense yet malleable with extremely high conductivity.

name: Tungsten
description: Unparalleled resistance to the elements but very heavy.

name: Epilar
description: Durable and resistant to stress but not really hard.

name: Eternium
description: Hard, durable, heat resisantant but poor under stress.

name: Orthite
description: Moderately conductive, stress resistant, but weak to heat.

name: Ash Wood
description: Extremely flexible all-rounder but heavy for timber.

name: Birch Wood
description: Soft but otherwise high performance for it's weight.

name: Cedar Wood
description: Extremely light and soft, cannot withstand much damage.

name: Chestnut Wood
description: Lightweight but nevertheless versatile timber.

name: Elm Wood
description: Medium weight with no outstanding strengths or vulnerabilities.

name: Hemlock Wood
description: Very light but durable enough to be used in certain scenarios.

name: Oak Wood
description: Durable and versatile but heavy for wood.

name: Palm Wood
description: The heaviest but also most useful wood.
